note: Shared orchestration registry. Tamar (Product Lead) reads/writes this. The GenerAgent product will bridge to it later (outbox/inbox). See README.md.

rules.no_shabbat: No outbound mailing/drafts on Saturday (Shabbat). If a recurring due date lands on Saturday, defer to Sunday.
rules.email_mode: draft_only — Tamar prepares a Gmail draft to roni@otegroup.co.il; Roni reviews and sends. The connector cannot auto-send.
rules.escalation: Agent blocked -> status 'blocked' -> Tamar drafts a decision email to CEO -> status 'awaiting_decision' until Roni replies.
rules.compliance_mailing: Any mailing to registered users (נרשמים) MUST include: an easy unsubscribe mechanism (link/reply/phone, free), publisher identity (OTE Group name + address + contact), and clear 'פרסומת' marking where the message is advertising — per Amendment 40 to the Israeli Communications Law. Applies to all user-facing sends, not internal reports to Roni.
